fact: Namibia Economist reports that CcHub Namibia hosted the Seedr Namibia 2.0 demo day for nine startup and student teams after weeks of mentorship, with two winners entering a 33-month incubation programme.

ITWeb Africa reports Namibia inaugurated the US$2 million Ondangwa digital Technology Hub, a multipurpose digital centre for education, innovation, conferences and community events, with no startup programme described.
CcHUB Director Jude Adejuwon says more than 200 Namibian startups have benefited from its training and acceleration programmes since 2021.
NCRST's BOOSTUP 2025/26, run with incubators Basecamp, CcHUB Namibia and NUST-i, began its Hunt Programme on 19 January 2026 for a cohort of 20 startups.
CcHUB says its Namibia hub ran the Seedr Namibia 2.0 AI Edition with nine teams at a 16 August 2025 demo day, and two winners entered a 3-month incubation programme.
